messages:
deploy-bot: Release candidate chart=transformer-v1.12 detected values drift for ingress.backend.image. expected=redwood/ingress-sidecar:v1.5.1 actual=redwood/ingress-sidecar:v1.6.0 in 4/25 canary pods. severity=notice, no automatic block. command: `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=transform-svc -o jsonpath='{.items[*].spec.containers[*].image}'`
anna_eng: saw the 502 spike earlier. good catch. where did the v1.6.0 come from? overlay or promoted chart?
matt: checked chart metadata: promoted chart version is 2.4.0, but overlay ingress-overlay.yaml sets `sidecar.image.tag: v1.6.0`. looks like overlay bump slipped through the branch.
lina: we have the change window for EU cohort until 17:00 UTC. options: reject promotion, pin value during promote, or split traffic. thoughts?
matt: I'd prefer pin-for-rollout + keep canary pool isolated. Plan: helm upgrade with `--set ingress.sidecar.tag=v1.5.1` and add a promotion metadata tag. Keep canary labeled with `release-type=canary` and scale to continue diagnostics.
anna_eng: draft commands:
```bash
# promote main with pin
helm upgrade transform-release charts/transformer --namespace prod --version 2.4.0 \
  --reuse-values \
  --set ingress.sidecar.tag=v1.5.1 \
  --set imagePromotion.note=pin-rollout-2026-04-02
# preserve canary pool
kubectl -n prod label deployment transform-svc release-type=canary --overwrite
```
release-manager: callout: put a short note in release notes and ping infra-oncall. also add the manual pin to the deployment audit.
lina: rollback surface? if pinned rollout causes regressions we should be able to `helm rollback transform-release 5`. but note: canary still running different sidecar so config parity mismatch is possible.
matt: mitigation steps: immediate rollback if errorRate>3% over 5m or podRestart>2. For canary, we can isolate by scaling canary replicas to zero: `kubectl -n prod scale deployment transform-svc-canary --replicas=0` until hotfix is ready.
anna_eng: opening ticket RD-5901 for sidecar alignment and adding to release-notes: "Pin ingress sidecar to v1.5.1 for rollout; observed v1.6.0 in canary overlay. Follow-up: sync overlays and ship patch."
release-manager: decision: proceed with pinned promote and keep canary running for analysis. @matt please run dry-run and paste helm template diff. also attach audit tag in helm values.
matt: dry-run shows overlay difference: `ingress.extraEnv.DEBUG=true` present only in canary overlay. including that in RD-5901. helm template diff below.
matt: ```diff
--- a/templates/deployment.yaml
+++ b/templates/deployment.yaml
@@
-        image: redwood/ingress-sidecar:v1.6.0
+        image: redwood/ingress-sidecar:v1.5.1  # pinned for rollout
```
lina: @oncall-bot can you create a 45m watch for transform-svc startup and error-rate? :eyes:
deploy-bot: Watch scheduled: transform-startup-watch (45m). thresholds: startup_latency>18s, error_rate>0.03, restart_count>2.
matt: executing promote now. will post completion ts.
anna_eng: release notes draft: impact=low, mitigation=manual pin, follow-up=overlay sync + point release. tagging RD-5901.
matt: promote complete at 3967800155. helm upgrade succeeded, rollout status progressing and then complete. left canary pool (4 pods) still running v1.6.0.
lina: monitoring looks stable. small spike during image pull but recovered. will keep watch until end of window.
release-manager: good work. close this thread after 30m if stable. action items: RD-5901 assigned to @matt and @anna_eng for overlay sync; include short blurb in release notes. :white_check_mark:
